ORDER : (per Shri Manoj Kumar Gupta, C.J.)
1. The present petition, under Article 226 of the
Constitution of India, is for the following reliefs :-
"1. Issue a writ of certiorari or a writ, order or direction in
the nature of certiorari quashing the impugned Uttarakhand
Sub Registrar Service (Amendment) Rules 2015 dated 31 July
2015 which is ultra vires to Section 6 of the Registration Act
1908 which classified the post of Sub Registrar into the
categories of Sub Registrar Grade II and Sub-Registrar Grade
I, arbitrarily and without any reasonable cause ; Or
2. Issue a writ of mandamus or a writ, order or direction in
the nature of mandamus commanding the respondents not to
apply the impugned Amendment Act of 2015 with a
retrospective effect ; and
1

3. Issue a writ of mandamus or a writ, order or direction in
the nature of mandamus commanding the respondents to pay
the revised pay scales of Rs 15600-39100 PAY GRADE RS
5400/- to the Petitioners at par with Sub Registrars who are
unreasonably designated as Grade I and to pay arrears of
wages together with such interest as may have accrued
thereon, from the date of the joining of services of the
Petitioner i.e. 05.03.2018 ;or"
2. Mr. Salman Khurshid, learned Senior Counsel
appearing for the petitioners, at the outset, states that, during
pendency of the writ petition, the petitioners have been
promoted from the post of Sub-Registrar Grade 2 to Sub-Registrar Grade I and, therefore, according to him, the
challenge to the Rules and the consequential reliefs does not
survive for consideration. He, however, submits that there are
other grievances, which have not been addressed, and liberty
be reserved in favour of the petitioners to approach the
Department for redressal of the said grievances.
3. Mr. J.P. Joshi, learned Additional Advocate General
appearing for the State has no objection in case such a liberty
is given to the petitioners.
4. Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed of as having
become infructuous, however, with liberty to the petitioners to
approach the Department in case any grievance, other than
those covered by the instant petition, survives for
consideration.
2

accordingly.
